mapper.select: SELECT account_sync_state_id AS id, codef_connection_id AS codefConnectionId, organization_code AS organizationCode, last_successful_synced_at AS lastSuccessfulSyncedAt, last_status AS lastStatus, last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ACCOUNT_SYNC_STATE WHERE codef_connection_id = #{codefConnectionId} AND organization_code = #{organizationCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOUNT_SYNC_STATE (codef_connection_id, organization_code, last_status) VALUES (#{codefConnectionId}, #{organizationCode}, #{lastStatus}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_sync_state_id = account_sync_state_id
